title: Towards Trustworthy AI: Characterizing User-Reported Risks across LLMs “In the Wild”

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting and clustering user-reported risks of demographic stereotyping from Reddit discussions using an LLM-based annotation pipeline and BERTopic modeling.
Extracting and clustering user-reported risks of racial prejudice and demographic stereotyping from Reddit discussions using an LLM-based annotation pipeline and BERTopic modeling.
Identifying user complaints about political bias, propaganda, and politically biased content moderation in Reddit discussions using top-down LLM extraction and bottom-up topic modeling.
Qualitative analysis of user-reported risks in Reddit discussions where LLM chatbots generated harmful stereotyping or blaming language regarding a user's health condition (e.g., cancer).
Extracting user-reported risks of demographic stereotyping related to nationality from Reddit discussions using an LLM-based annotation pipeline.
Extracting user-reported risks of linguistic underrepresentation from Reddit discussions using an LLM-based annotation pipeline and topic clustering.
